measure.meaning: Average number of person-truces the dweller holds in good standing (0 to 2). At 0 the dweller shares no Margin with anyone, which is loneliness; at 2 both bond slots are held.

Average strain the two residents carry and have not exported, after the first month. In this world that is loneliness: strain that cannot leave a closed person. Lower means less loneliness. A snap also lowers it by dumping the excess into the crowd, so read the snap counts alongside it.
Mean breath reserve of the resident after the first month. Higher means R is answered firmly enough not to thin; falling toward zero is loneliness as physical fading.

Average fraction of the resident held in full form by recognition after the first day. Low values mean the resident is blurring through too few comprehending witnesses: loneliness in this world's sense. 0 is Blank.

Average shortfall between the belonging a resident needs and the depth of the ties they actually hold, after a 50-day warm-up and across three moves; 0 means no loneliness, 0.5 means no settled ties at all.
Average share of the disc's residents who have neither a consort nor a pairing under way, after the first 20 years of settling.
Share of neighbours' reach-outs that are met by another neighbour's reach-out within one tick; near 0 means everyone reaches out into others' silence (loneliness), near 1 means reach-outs meet.

Share of time, once the settled household's own seam has frozen, that the newcomer D is part of one conduit with A and B, so that a signal sent from D reaches them. Time without it is time D shares nothing with anyone nearby, which is loneliness in this world.
Share of residents at hour 400 who keep no settled span: those living alone in a dimmed, flat world plus those in a trial span that still flickers. Lower means fewer lonely residents.
Average lasting bond-form the dweller holds with the people where they currently live; 0 means wholly alone, and higher means stronger and longer-held local friendship.
